tieu_de: Senior Telematics Software Engineer Linux / Android
ten_cong_ty: Bosch Global Software Technologies Company Limited
mo_ta_cong_viec:
Bosch is looking for Senior Telematics Software Engineers to develop next-generation connected vehicle solutions across Commercial Vehicle / Off-Highway and Passenger Car programs.
Depending on your technical expertise, you will work primarily in one of two areas: Embedded Linux/RTOS or Embedded Android/AOSP. You are not required to be an expert in both.
What You’ll Do
Design, develop and maintain embedded software for Telematics Control Unit (TCU) platforms.
Develop vehicle communication and diagnostic functions using CAN/CAN-FD, J1939, UDS, DoIP and related automotive protocols.
Develop connectivity features including 4G/5G, GNSS, MQTT/HTTPS and cloud communication.
Develop and maintain OTA (FOTA/SOTA), remote diagnostics and vehicle data services.
Perform software integration, debugging, testing and vehicle-level validation.
Collaborate with global OEM customers, platform, cloud/backend and hardware teams.
Depending on your expertise, contribute to either:
Embedded Linux/RTOS: Linux-based TCU development, Yocto/Buildroot and embedded platform integration; OR
Embedded Android/AOSP: AOSP/Android Automotive, HAL/VHAL, AIDL/HIDL, Android System Services and Linux-to-Android platform migration.
yeu_cau:
What You Need
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering or related field.
5+ years of experience in Embedded Software, Automotive, Telematics or related fields.
Strong programming skills in C/C++.
Good understanding of embedded systems and software development.
Experience with automotive communication protocols such as CAN/CAN-FD, UDS, DoIP or J1939.
Experience with connectivity, diagnostics, OTA or telematics is highly preferred.
Familiarity with Git, CI/CD and embedded debugging/testing tools.
We welcome candidates with strong expertise in EITHER of the following tracks:
Embedded Linux / RTOS
Embedded Linux and/or RTOS
Yocto / Buildroot
ARM-based embedded platforms
Embedded connectivity and networking
OR
Embedded Android / AOSP
Embedded Android / AOSP / Android Automotive
HAL / VHAL and AIDL / HIDL
Android System Services
SELinux and Android build system
Linux-to-Android migration experience is highly preferred
You do not need to meet both tracks. Strong expertise in either Embedded Linux/RTOS or Embedded Android/AOSP is welcome.
